purpose: Cross-source method-fidelity benchmark for the Kissinger non-isothermal cure-kinetics estimator on GENUINELY rights-clean (CC-BY-4.0, commercial + derivative use permitted) two-part epoxy-amine DSC datasets. Extends the single-dataset anchor (cure-kinetics-kissinger-ccby-anchor-v1) into a multi-system suite so the estimator is validated across independent labs and amine chemistries, not one formulation.
non_circularity: For every system the estimator consumes ONLY the raw (heating_rate, peak_temperature) pairs. Each paper's reported Kissinger Ea is read ONLY as a validation target, never as an input. Recovering each paper's Kissinger Ea from its raw peaks is therefore a genuine method-fidelity test, not a tautology.

scope_tiers.CORE_DGEBA_AMINE: Two-part epoxy where the epoxy is DGEBA (diglycidyl ether of bisphenol A, optionally with a glycidyl-ether reactive diluent) cured with an amine hardener. Directly in the marine anti-corrosion two-part epoxy-amine IP scope. Contributes to the core pass/fail KPI.
scope_tiers.GENERALIZATION_EPOXY_AMINE: Epoxy-amine thermoset whose epoxy backbone is NOT DGEBA (e.g. multifunctional aerospace resin). Included ONLY to test whether the Kissinger estimator generalizes across the broader epoxy-amine reactivity class. Reported honestly but EXCLUDED from the core DGEBA pass/fail KPI so no adjacent-industry data can inflate the in-scope result.
